org.xces.graf.uima.convert
Class Graf2CAS

java.lang.Object
  org.xces.graf.uima.convert.Graf2CAS

public class Graf2CAS
extends Object

uses App.java to utilize command line input. This class is an updated version of example.java by Madhav Krishna of how one can use the CASFactory class to convert a Graph to a CAS: updated to work with xmlns="http://www.xces.org/ns/GrAF/1.0/

1.0

Cascio
